1 سَلَحَ , (S, Mgh, K,) aor.
سَلَحَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. سَلْح, (S, Mgh, Msb,) said of a man, (TA,) He voided his excrement, or ordure; (S, K;) [or thin excrement: see سَلْحٌ: and] said of a bird, it muted, or dunged; (Msb;) like تَغَوَّطَ (Mgh, * Msb) said of a man: (Msb:) and said also [of other animals, as, for instance,] of a camel, (S, K, TA,) and of a bull. (K in art. ثلط.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
